title: Global, regional, and national mortality among young people aged 10–24 years, 1950–2019: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2019
summary: Using GBD 2019 estimates, the study examines deaths and mortality rates among 10–24-year-olds in 204 countries and territories from 1950 to 2019. Variation in adolescent mortality between countries and by sex is widening.
keyFindings: Differences in adolescent mortality between countries and by sex are widening.
This is driven by poor progress in reducing deaths among males and older adolescents.
methods: Global Burden of Disease 2019 estimates for 204 countries and territories, 1950–2019 (causes from 1980).
